meta.title: Session cost
meta.description: Shows the estimated DeepSeek API cost of the current session: the stats strip gives the cost and the current peak/off-peak rate (red for peak, green for off-peak), and a "Cost" entry beside the session title opens a breakdown panel with a 24-hour bar chart, hourly rows, and a per-day archive. Cost is booked per pricing tier, with the 2026 Chinese public holidays built in.
